html:
Perks › Legendary

Midas Touch

Legendary perk · Score multiplier

On a scoring play, all point bonuses from perks are doubled.

In-game card text

How it works

On a scoring play, all point bonuses from perks are doubled for each copy: two copies make them four times as large.

  • The open-end total itself is not doubled, only the perk bonuses. Skill bonuses such as Coffin Corner and the points Pip Shield gives back are not doubled either.
  • Golden Double and The Equalizer come after Midas Touch, so they double its result again.

Worked example

Ends total 20 with Double Trouble (+5) and Hot Streak (+5): 20 + 10 = 30. Midas Touch adds another 10, so the play scores 40. If it was a double and you also hold Golden Double, it becomes 80.

At a glance

RarityLegendary
TypeScore multiplier
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itComplete its three career trials (Earn 5,000 points; Make a 50-point play; Acquire 25 different perks), then unlock it for 1,500 Bone Bucks.
